are-archaeal-dark-genes-methanogen-speci.reason: Ortholog breadth across archaeal and bacterial genomes and existing Fitness Browser conditions decide it; the unmeasured metal panel would only add confirmation.

are-co-occurring-resistance-gene-groups-.reason: Decided by tracing each resistance gene group's gain history across core-genome trees of pangenome species in the KBase Data Lakehouse.

are-cofitness-modules-co-inherited-acros.reason: Adjacent and non-adjacent module members against control gene sets sharing prevalence and mean fitness, across genomes, decide it using existing Fitness Browser modules and pangenome presence tables.

are-efflux-pumps-tied-to-amino-acid-bios.reason: Deciding it needs new graded amino-acid sensitivity assays in one organism, since Fitness Browser supplementation conditions may be too sparse.

are-essential-auxiliary-genes-essential-.reason: Mobile-element neighbourhoods of essential-auxiliary genes and core-paralog presence in relatives, from KBase Data Lakehouse pangenome and genome data, decide the hypothesis.

are-exou-carrying-cystic-fibrosis-pseudo.reason: Whether ExoU and ExoS carriers sit in environmental clades and diverge in accessory genes is decided by a core-genome tree and accessory-gene comparison on existing pangenome genomes.

are-gapfilled-reactions-without-ec-numbe.reason: Catalysis by a candidate enzyme family is only shown by in vitro activity, so the hypothesis needs a lab assay after a lakehouse analysis narrows the candidates.

are-gene-families-essential-in-some-bact.reason: Whether backup copies track essentiality is decided by Fitness Browser calls and pangenome gene content, needing medium, library depth, insertion bias, gene length and relatedness accounted for.

are-latent-biosynthetic-and-catabolic-pa.reason: Decided by whether latent pathways are absent from more same-species genomes than active ones, most for carbon versus amino acid pathways, plus whether latent-rich species vary more.

are-metal-specific-genes-kept-patchily-i.reason: Decided by whether metal-specific gene presence across same-species genomes tracks contaminated isolation habitats, using KBase Data Lakehouse gene, pangenome and habitat records.

are-widely-conserved-core-proteins-with-.reason: Fitness data for shallow-family core genes in existing BERDL collections decides it, after joining cluster members to Fitness Browser genes.

do-accessory-genes-show-fitness-effects-.reason: Deciding the hypothesis needs condition-specific fitness calls for core and accessory genes, split by experiment type; the Fitness Browser and pangenome links hold these.

do-costly-dispensable-genes-with-conditi.reason: Existing Fitness Browser phenotypes and pangenome links in the KBase Data Lakehouse can decide whether these genes persist more widely, so no new experiment is needed.

do-dark-genes-that-resist-reannotation-w.reason: Deciding it needs new co-culture fitness screens, since existing Fitness Browser data lack enough mixed-community experiments to test interaction functions.

do-efflux-genes-matter-under-antibiotics.reason: Knockout fitness of resistance genes across existing Fitness Browser experiments decides it, needing drug-spectrum labels from annotations.

do-extreme-metal-tolerant-bacteria-rely-.reason: Deciding whether specialist gene families separate bioleaching genera needs literature-based bioleaching labels gathered from outside sources, plus pangenome data already in BERDL.

do-genes-spanning-regulation-and-metabol.reason: Whether transferred regulator-adjacent genes exceed vertical ones is decided by counting neighbours in existing gain-event, annotation and contig position tables.

do-gt2-sugar-polymer-genes-mark-a-distin.reason: Whether metal resistance tracks GT2-adjacent T4SS genomes can be decided from existing lakehouse genomes, annotations and habitat labels.

do-host-associated-bacteria-track-host-b.reason: Body-site labels harmonised from BioSamples text and gene content across pangenome genomes, both already in BERDL, decide the hypothesis.

do-iron-scavenging-gene-clusters-give-es.reason: Growth advantage under iron limitation needs new pairwise competition assays; scoring genome carriage in the KBase Data Lakehouse narrows which strain pairs to test.

do-metal-resistance-hotspots-in-environm.reason: Deciding it needs measured metal concentrations at matched sites, which are not confirmed in BERDL and must be gathered from other studies.

do-newly-acquired-resistance-genes-pay-a.reason: Fitness Browser knockout data and genome sequences in BERDL can test whether host-like composition predicts lower resistance-gene cost.

do-partly-working-truncated-proteins-let.reason: Deciding it needs new early-insertion and full-deletion strains tested for growth, since existing insertion maps cannot show whether early insertions are lethal.

do-phyla-without-phb-carry-other-carbon-.reason: Scoring glycogen, polyphosphate and lipid storage genes across BERDL pangenome species decides it, needing only existing annotations and genome sizes.

do-rare-earth-rich-acid-sites-use-lantha.reason: Whether candidates bind lanthanides more strongly than calcium needs a lab binding measurement; BERDL genomes can first pick the candidates to test.

do-rare-earth-rich-sites-select-lanthani.reason: Only lab cultures with added lanthanum, measuring xoxF expression and uptake, can decide the hypothesis; BERDL metagenomes come first to narrow it.

do-the-crohn-s-linked-pathobionts-themse.reason: Only cultured pathobionts, singly and in a pooled community with and without them, profiled by metabolomics can show which axis metabolites they make.

do-the-metabolic-ecotypes-within-a-bacte.reason: Ecotype-versus-subclade matching to isolation environment, using BERDL pathway and metadata, decides it, including whether variable pathways are nutrient routes tied to each habitat's nutrient sources.

do-unannotated-genes-in-field-relevant-c.reason: Only growing the mutants in groundwater-like and standard lab medium decides whether defects are specific to groundwater conditions; the lakehouse lacks that chemistry.

do-water-table-layers-not-lateral-distan.reason: Depth versus lateral position needs existing community data; whether chemistry tracks community turnover needs registered geochemistry measurements not yet loaded.

do-zinc-and-iron-stress-overlap-because-.reason: Whether iron rescues zinc sensitivity in iron-sulfur gene deletions decides it, needing new growth measurements after existing fitness data choose the genes.

does-a-burst-of-nadh-on-quinate-make-com.reason: Deciding the hypothesis needs new NADH redox measurements and genetic rescue experiments in ADP1 strains; existing data lack these.

does-an-open-pangenome-weaken-the-link-b.reason: Existing BERDL fitness and pangenome tables can decide whether the essential-gene core link weakens with openness; only the cross-organism comparison is new.

does-carrying-both-aromatic-and-non-arom.reason: Co-carriage can be checked in existing genome calls, but whether generalists grow slower than same-genus specialists and use mixtures in sequence needs new growth assays.

does-contamination-select-defense-gene-r.reason: Comparing defense genes in isolate genomes from high and low contamination wells decides it, using ENIGMA CORAL well links; whether enough isolates qualify is unestablished.

does-desulfovibrio-vulgaris-make-serine-.reason: Growth without added serine and labelled serine in defined medium decide the hypothesis, and only a new lab experiment can supply them.

does-essential-metal-cofactor-handling-n.reason: Whether uptake and cofactor genes are more often core than detoxification genes, using existing Fitness Browser and Pangenome data.

does-growth-predictability-from-gene-con.reason: Fitness, pangenome conservation and growth panel data already in the KBase Data Lakehouse can decide it through a newly written analysis.

does-lipid-a-loss-in-caulobacter-need-bo.reason: Deciding whether lipid A loss is viable needs new knockout, rescue and lipidomics experiments in Caulobacter strains; existing data cannot test it.

does-measured-metal-tolerance-follow-cat.reason: Deciding it needs new measured inhibitory concentrations for matched strains, since BERDL lacks per-metal values; existing records only choose strains.

does-quinate-need-iron-and-pqq-support-g.reason: Rescue of quinate growth by iron or PQQ in ADP1 mutants needs new growth measurements; pangenome co-occurrence runs alongside, not before.

does-snipe-persist-only-where-phages-ent.reason: Only new Klebsiella mutant libraries and phage challenges can decide whether SNIPE protection depends on the mannose transporter; BERDL co-occurrence only narrows candidates.

does-soil-carbon-pathway-completeness-ri.reason: Deciding it needs paired taxonomy and metabolomics from at least two soil studies, which BERDL may already hold.

does-the-butyrate-producer-anaerostipes-.reason: Only anaerobic co-culture and defined-community add/remove assays measuring lactate, butyrate and growth can decide whether pathobionts change Anaerostipes caccae lactate use or butyrate output.

does-the-same-gut-species-become-crohn-s.reason: Only a gnotobiotic mouse experiment can decide whether candidate expansion depends on community state, after a BERDL cohort analysis narrows the candidates.

does-warming-deplete-labile-carbon-in-mi.reason: Respiration after labile substrate addition needs new incubations of heated and control soil, and existing metabolite lists cannot measure it.

does-warming-raise-methane-oxidation-by-.reason: Decided by paired measurements of methane uptake and pmoA transcript-to-DNA ratios in heated versus control soils, which need new sampling.

is-a-resistance-gene-s-conservation-set-.reason: Core versus accessory resistance genes within each mechanism class, judged by non-antibiotic stress fitness and how closely their fitness tracks non-resistance genes, decides it.

is-adp1-s-smooth-phenotype-landscape-cau.reason: Whether ADP1's smoothness reflects condition count or perturbation type can only be settled by pooling an ADP1 transposon library grown on the same carbon sources.

is-environmental-adaptation-hidden-in-a-.reason: Whether accessory defense and mobile-element genes track isolation environment within environment-blind species is decided by existing pangenome gene-cluster and isolation-source data.

is-one-denitrifier-s-costly-dispensable-.reason: Decided by new pooled mutant competition under aerobic and anaerobic nitrate growth, since existing RCH2 oxygen data are confounded with metal salt.

is-soil-habitat-associated-with-xoxf-gai.reason: Within-genus habitat comparisons and gain/loss mapping on genome trees use existing pangenome and habitat data in the lakehouse, though habitat coverage per genome is uncertain.

is-storage-polymer-production-acquired-b.reason: Support and refute both need the within-genus habitat comparison from BERDL and a deletion mutant starvation-cycle test, so a new experiment decides it.

is-the-acetate-specific-defect-of-aciad3.reason: Deciding it needs new growth, redox and rescue measurements on ADP1 deletion strains, since BERDL lacks these phenotypes.

is-the-acid-and-warmth-niche-split-betwe.reason: Growth in monoculture and co-culture across a pH series must be measured in the lab; BERDL sample data cannot separate competition from tolerance.

is-the-groundwater-versus-sediment-split.reason: Only simultaneous sampling of groundwater and sediment from the same wells can show whether the partition persists or was caused by timing.

is-the-larger-genome-of-cultured-deep-cl.reason: Deciding it needs published deep-rock metagenome-assembled Bacillota_B genomes, whose presence in the KBase Data Lakehouse is unestablished, beside cultured and soil genomes.

is-the-near-universal-urea-defect-a-nitr.reason: Only new growth assays of the ADP1 deletion collection on urea, a non-urea nitrogen source, and a growth-matched slow control can decide it.

is-the-negative-pairing-of-nitrogen-fixa.reason: Whether the pairing survives within genera is decided by genome co-carriage in existing pangenome data, not by new strain assays.

is-the-overlap-between-metal-and-salt-fi.reason: Fitness Browser gene sets for metals and NaCl, compared with sorbitol and envelope conditions, decide it; those experiments' coverage per organism is unverified.

is-the-resistance-gene-excess-in-clinica.reason: Deciding it needs public antibiotic-resistance ontology terms to classify clusters, alongside existing pangenome and environment data from BERDL.

is-tryptophan-released-by-pseudomonas-fl.reason: Cross-feeding is decided by spent-medium growth of auxotrophs, which only a new experiment can measure; BERDL gene and pathway calls narrow candidates.

is-uranium-itself-or-acidity-and-nitrate.reason: Separating uranium from acidity and nitrate needs controlled microcosms, because field samples confound these causes and cannot isolate uranium.

is-xoxf-mostly-a-methanol-enzyme-or-does.reason: Deciding whether XoxF serves other alcohols needs enzyme assays, but a BERDL genome analysis of methylotrophy genes must first narrow which carriers to test.

was-lanmodulin-spread-by-horizontal-tran.reason: Gene-tree versus species-tree conflict, flanking mobile-element genes and base composition versus host decide transfer, using existing pangenome genomes and new analysis.

were-plant-growth-genes-acquired-ancient.reason: Whether plant-growth genes were gained anciently is decided by whether core copies show deep gains while recent gains stay among accessory copies, using existing pangenome and UniRef data.

were-sugar-pathways-lost-repeatedly-with.reason: Growth of CF and environmental isolates on sorbitol, mannitol and gluconate decides it, after a pangenome analysis of lung-branch pathway losses.

what-do-lanmodulin-carrying-bacteria-wit.reason: Deciding it needs growth and metal-uptake tests in a xoxF-free strain; BERDL screening first narrows which strain to use.

why-are-fungal-lignin-enrichment-communi.reason: Only new enrichment cultures across an inoculum dilution series, with deeper fungal sequencing, can decide whether fungal replicate agreement recovers at high inoculum.

why-is-the-model-sulfate-reducer-desulfo.reason: Deciding it needs a new dsrAB assay on anaerobic-well sediment and groundwater, after existing ENIGMA CORAL profile comparison narrows the targets.
